description: This file defines a template class 'TokenizedStringList' that provides functionality for tokenizing strings based on a separator character, optionally removing whitespaces, and managing the list of tokens. It includes methods for tokenization, access, and manipulation of the token list.

classes.name: TokenizedStringList
classes.description: A template class that manages a list of string tokens, providing methods for tokenization, access, and manipulation based on a separator character and whitespace removal option.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens based on the specified separator, optionally removing whitespace characters before tokenization.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all tokens from the list.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Returns the first token in the list.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Concatenates all tokens into a single string separated by the separator character.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the token list is empty.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of tokens in the list.
